none: PAS FindID 913564: Roman Coin: Siliqua, probably of the House of Valentinian
contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Silver coin. Siliqua of an indeterminate later Roman ruler, probably of the House of Valentinian (364-378), clipped with loss of all legends. Style of bust might point to Trier mint, an Urbs Roma issue of 368-378. The finder suggests this may be clipped to conform with the weight of the sceatta coinage found in abundance in the vicinity. Obverse description: Bust diademed draped and cuirassed…
